# Niederschlagsradar-Animation: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/radar-animation/

> Regen und Schnee der nächsten drei Stunden in 15-Minuten-Schritten als Animation auf der Karte: Nowcast von GeoSphere Austria, lauffähiger Code.

Das TileJSON `/v1/weather/tiles/rr_nowcast.json` nennt die 15-Minuten-Schritte unter `mapx:time.times`. Das Beispiel legt je Schritt einen Raster-Layer an und schaltet deren Sichtbarkeit um, damit die Animation nicht auf Kacheln wartet. Für einen einzelnen Punkt gibt es `GET /v1/weather/nowcast/{lon},{lat}`. OpenLayers lädt einen Layer erst, wenn er sichtbar wird: Die OpenLayers-Fassung holt jeden Schritt beim ersten Zeigen, danach kommt er aus dem Cache.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Precipitation radar: nowcast tiles (15-minute steps, 3 hours) as an animation over the map.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const API = 'https://api.mapx.at/v1';
const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: API + '/styles/streets', center: [13.3, 47.6], zoom: 6.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
let times = [], timer = null;

function zeigen(i) {
  const t = times[i];
  document.getElementById('zeit').value = i;
  const source = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de') ? 'Quelle' : 'Source'; // page language
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = `Radar nowcast ${t} (UTC), ${source}: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0`;
  // one layer per time step, only the selected one is visible: tiles are already loaded when playing
  times.forEach((_, k) => map.setLayoutProperty('radar-' + k, 'visibility', k === i ? 'visible' : 'none'));
}

function abspielen() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('play');
  if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; btn.textContent = de ? 'Abspielen' : 'Play'; return; }
  btn.textContent = 'Pause';
  timer = setInterval(() => zeigen((Number(document.getElementById('zeit').value) + 1) % times.length), 700);
}

map.on('load', async () => {
  const tj = await (await fetch(`${API}/weather/tiles/rr_nowcast.json`, AUTH)).json();
  times = tj['mapx:time'].times; // 15-Minuten-Schritte (UTC)
  document.getElementById('zeit').max = times.length - 1;
  times.forEach((t, k) => {
    map.addSource('radar-' + k, {
      type: 'raster', tileSize: 512, maxzoom: 10,
      tiles: [tj['mapx:time'].template.replace('{time}', t)],
      attribution: 'Wetter: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0',
    });
    map.addLayer({ id: 'radar-' + k, type: 'raster', source: 'radar-' + k, layout: { visibility: 'none' }, paint: { 'raster-opacity': 0.85, 'raster-fade-duration': 0 } });
  });
  zeigen(0);
});
document.getElementById('play').addEventListener('click', abspielen);
document.getElementById('zeit').addEventListener('input', (e) => zeigen(Number(e.target.value)));
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Precipitation radar: nowcast tiles (15-minute steps, 3 hours) as an animation over the map.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const API = 'https://api.mapx.at/v1';
const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([13.3, 47.6]), zoom: 7.5 }) });
let times = [], layers = [], timer = null;

function zeigen(i) {
  const t = times[i];
  document.getElementById('zeit').value = i;
  const source = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de') ? 'Quelle' : 'Source'; // page language
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = `Radar nowcast ${t} (UTC), ${source}: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0`;
  // one layer per time step, only the selected one is visible: OpenLayers loads a step when first shown, later from the cache
  layers.forEach((l, k) => l.setVisible(k === i));
}

function abspielen() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('play');
  if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; btn.textContent = de ? 'Abspielen' : 'Play'; return; }
  btn.textContent = 'Pause';
  timer = setInterval(() => zeigen((Number(document.getElementById('zeit').value) + 1) % times.length), 700);
}

(async () => {
  const tj = await (await fetch(`${API}/weather/tiles/rr_nowcast.json`, AUTH)).json();
  times = tj['mapx:time'].times; // 15-minute steps (UTC)
  document.getElementById('zeit').max = times.length - 1;
  layers = times.map((t, k) => new ol.layer.Tile({
    opacity: 0.85, visible: false,
    source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: tj['mapx:time'].template.replace('{time}', t) + '?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 10, transition: 0, attributions: k ? undefined : 'Wetter: GeoSphere Austria, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>' }),
  }));
  layers.forEach((l) => map.addLayer(l));
  zeigen(0);
})();
document.getElementById('play').addEventListener('click', abspielen);
document.getElementById('zeit').addEventListener('input', (e) => zeigen(Number(e.target.value)));
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Precipitation radar: nowcast tiles (15-minute steps, 3 hours) as an animation over the map.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; the radar layers add their own; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';
const API = 'https://api.mapx.at/v1';

const map = L.map('map').setView([47.6, 13.3], 7);
L.tileLayer(API + '/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
let times = [], template = '', layers = [], timer = null;
function zeigen(i) {
  document.getElementById('zeit').value = i;
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = `Radar nowcast ${times[i]} (UTC), ${de ? 'Quelle' : 'Source'}: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0`;
  // one layer per time step, created on first use and then kept hidden: the second round plays without waiting for tiles
  layers[i] ??= L.tileLayer(template.replace('{time}', times[i]) + '?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, maxNativeZoom: 11, maxZoom: 21, opacity: 0, attribution: 'Wetter: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0' }).addTo(map);
  layers.forEach((l, k) => l?.setOpacity(k === i ? 0.85 : 0));
}
function abspielen() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('play');
  if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; btn.textContent = de ? 'Abspielen' : 'Play'; return; }
  btn.textContent = 'Pause';
  timer = setInterval(() => zeigen((Number(document.getElementById('zeit').value) + 1) % times.length), 700);
}
(async () => {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/weather/tiles/rr_nowcast.json`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const time = (await res.json())['mapx:time'];
    times = time.times; // 15-minute steps (UTC)
    template = time.template; // tile URL with {time}
    document.getElementById('zeit').max = times.length - 1;
    zeigen(0);
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
})();
document.getElementById('play').addEventListener('click', abspielen);
document.getElementById('zeit').addEventListener('input', (e) => zeigen(Number(e.target.value)));
````

> Datenquelle: GeoSphere Austria, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Die Namensnennung ist Pflicht.

In Leaflet ist jeder Schritt eine eigene `L.tileLayer`, umgeschaltet wird über die Deckkraft.

## Verwendete APIs

- [Wetter](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/weather.md#weather-raster-tile-png-256-transparent-outside-the-data) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/weather/tiles/rr_nowcast.json`, `GET api.mapx.at/v1/weather/tiles/rr_nowcast/{time}/{z}/{x}/{y}.png`
- [Niederschlags-Nowcast](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/weather.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/weather/nowcast/{lon},{lat}`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Isochronen: Beispiel Erreichbarkeit

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/isochrone/

> Welche Fläche ist in 5, 10 und 15 Minuten erreichbar? Isochronen (Erreichbarkeit) mit der mapx-Routing-API zeichnen; lauffähiger Code zum Kopieren.

Ein Klick setzt den Startpunkt. Die Isochronen-API liefert je Stufe ein MultiPolygon, die größte Fläche zuerst.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Isochrones: areas reachable in 5, 10 and 15 minutes.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [15.33, 48.23], zoom: 13 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('iso', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'iso-flaeche', type: 'fill', source: 'iso', paint: { 'fill-color': '#2346d8', 'fill-opacity': 0.12 } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'iso-linie', type: 'line', source: 'iso', paint: { 'line-color': '#2346d8', 'line-width': 2 } });
  abfragen([15.33, 48.23]);
});
map.on('click', (e) => abfragen([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]));

async function abfragen(ort) {
  const profil = document.getElementById('profil').value; // walking, cycling or driving
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/isochrone/${profil}/${ort.join(',')}?contours_minutes=5,10,15`;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(url, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    map.getSource('iso').setData(await r.json()); // one MultiPolygon per step, largest first
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Isochrones: areas reachable in 5, 10 and 15 minutes.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const iso = new ol.source.Vector();
const area = new ol.style.Style({ fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color: 'rgba(35, 70, 216, 0.12)' }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#2346d8', width: 2 }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: iso, style: area })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([15.33, 48.23]), zoom: 14 }) }); // Melk
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates

map.on('click', (e) => abfragen(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate)));
abfragen([15.33, 48.23]);

async function abfragen(ort) {
  const profil = document.getElementById('profil').value; // walking, cycling or driving
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/isochrone/${profil}/${ort.join(',')}?contours_minutes=5,10,15`;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(url, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    iso.clear();
    iso.addFeatures(geojson.readFeatures(await r.json())); // one MultiPolygon per step, largest first
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Isochrones: areas reachable in 5, 10 and 15 minutes.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the routing (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.23, 15.33], 14); // Melk
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const iso = L.geoJSON(null, { style: { color: '#2346d8', weight: 2, opacity: 1, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 0.12 } }).addTo(map);
map.on('click', (e) => abfragen([e.latlng.lng, e.latlng.lat]));
abfragen([15.33, 48.23]);
async function abfragen(ort) {
  const profil = document.getElementById('profil').value; // walking, cycling or driving
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/isochrone/${profil}/${ort.join(',')}?contours_minutes=5,10,15`;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(url, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    iso.clearLayers().addData(await r.json()); // one MultiPolygon per step, largest first
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

# Fahrzeitmatrix: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/matrix/

> Fahrzeiten zwischen mehreren Orten in einer Anfrage mit der mapx-Matrix-API berechnen (Fahrzeitmatrix): lauffähiges Beispiel zum Kopieren.

Die Matrix-API nimmt Quellen (und optional Ziele) und liefert Dauer (und optional Distanz) für alle Paare, `null` heißt nicht routbar.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Matrix: Fahrzeiten zwischen mehreren Orten in einer Anfrage.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const ORTE = { Melk: [15.33, 48.228], 'St. Pölten': [15.626, 48.204], Krems: [15.6, 48.41], Amstetten: [14.87, 48.123] };
const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [15.3, 48.25], zoom: 8 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
for (const [name, p] of Object.entries(ORTE)) new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(p).setPopup(new maplibregl.Popup().setText(name)).addTo(map);

document.getElementById('los').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const tabelle = document.getElementById('ergebnis'), namen = Object.keys(ORTE);
  try {
    const koordinaten = Object.values(ORTE).map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';');
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/matrix/driving/${koordinaten}`, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const { durations } = await r.json(); // seconds, null = not routable
    tabelle.innerHTML = '<tr><th></th>' + namen.map((n) => `<th>${n}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>' +
      durations.map((zeile, i) => `<tr><th>${namen[i]}</th>` + zeile.map((s) => `<td>${s == null ? '–' : Math.round(s / 60) + ' min'}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>').join('');
  } catch (err) { tabelle.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Matrix: driving times between several places in one request.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const ORTE = { Melk: [15.33, 48.228], 'St. Pölten': [15.626, 48.204], Krems: [15.6, 48.41], Amstetten: [14.87, 48.123] };
const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const places = new ol.source.Vector({ features: Object.entries(ORTE).map(([name, p]) => new ol.Feature({ geometry: new ol.geom.Point(ol.proj.fromLonLat(p)), name })) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const label = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
label.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: label, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -8] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: places, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([15.3, 48.25]), zoom: 9 }) });
map.on('click', (e) => {
  const f = map.forEachFeatureAtPixel(e.pixel, (x) => x);
  label.textContent = f?.get('name') ?? '';
  popup.setPosition(f?.getGeometry().getCoordinates());
});

document.getElementById('los').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const tabelle = document.getElementById('ergebnis'), namen = Object.keys(ORTE);
  const zelle = (tag, text) => Object.assign(document.createElement(tag), { textContent: text });
  const zeile = (kopf, zellen, tag = 'td') => tabelle.insertRow().append(zelle('th', kopf), ...zellen.map((z) => zelle(tag, z)));
  try {
    const koordinaten = Object.values(ORTE).map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';');
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/matrix/driving/${koordinaten}`, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const { durations } = await r.json(); // seconds, null = not routable
    tabelle.replaceChildren();
    zeile('', namen, 'th');
    durations.forEach((z, i) => zeile(namen[i], z.map((s) => (s == null ? '–' : Math.round(s / 60) + ' min'))));
  } catch (err) { tabelle.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Matrix: driving times between several places in one request.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the routing (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const ORTE = { Melk: [15.33, 48.228], 'St. Pölten': [15.626, 48.204], Krems: [15.6, 48.41], Amstetten: [14.87, 48.123] };
const map = L.map('map').setView([48.25, 15.3], 9);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
for (const [name, [lng, lat]] of Object.entries(ORTE)) L.circleMarker([lat, lng], { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).bindPopup(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: name })).addTo(map);
document.getElementById('los').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const tabelle = document.getElementById('ergebnis'), namen = Object.keys(ORTE);
  const zeile = (kopf, zellen) => { const tr = document.createElement('tr'); tr.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('th'), { textContent: kopf }), ...zellen.map((z) => Object.assign(document.createElement(z.th ? 'th' : 'td'), { textContent: z.text }))); return tr; };
  try {
    const koordinaten = Object.values(ORTE).map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';');
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/matrix/driving/${koordinaten}`, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const { durations } = await r.json(); // seconds, null = not routable
    tabelle.replaceChildren(zeile('', namen.map((n) => ({ th: true, text: n }))), ...durations.map((z, i) => zeile(namen[i], z.map((s) => ({ text: s == null ? '–' : Math.round(s / 60) + ' min' })))));
  } catch (err) { tabelle.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

# Kataster: Grundstück per Klick

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/parcel-on-click/

> Grundstücksgrenzen (Kataster) über dem Luftbild zeigen, ein Klick nennt die Grundstücksnummer: Kataster-Tileset und Parcel-API, lauffähiger Code.

Das Kataster-Tileset enthält die Grenzlinien ab Zoom 16 mit Grundstücksnummer und Katastralgemeinde. `queryRenderedFeatures` liest sie am Klickpunkt. OpenLayers und Leaflet zeigen das Luftbild als Rasterkacheln ohne Grenzlinien; dort fragt ein Klick die Parcel-API und zeichnet den Umriss des Grundstücks.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Cadastre: a click on a parcel boundary shows the parcel number and cadastral municipality.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/satellite', center: [15.3306, 48.2275], zoom: 18 }); // Melk
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)

map.on('load', () => {
  // Grenzlinien sichtbar machen (im Stil als Ebene "parcel", Quelle "cadastre", ab Zoom 16)
  map.setLayoutProperty('parcel', 'visibility', 'visible');
});
map.on('click', (e) => {
  const box = [[e.point.x - 6, e.point.y - 6], [e.point.x + 6, e.point.y + 6]];
  const f = map.queryRenderedFeatures(box, { layers: ['parcel'] })[0];
  const text = f ? (de ? `Grundstück ${f.properties.gstnr}, Katastralgemeinde ${f.properties.kgnr}` : `Parcel ${f.properties.gstnr}, cadastral municipality ${f.properties.kgnr}`) : (de ? 'Keine Grundstücksgrenze getroffen (sichtbar ab Zoom 16).' : 'No parcel boundary hit (visible from zoom 16).');
  new maplibregl.Popup().setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText(text).addTo(map);
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Cadastre: a click asks the Parcel API for the parcel at that point, draws its outline and shows parcel number and cadastral municipality.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = 'Orthophoto: <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://basemap.at">basemap.at</a>; BEV – DKM; <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/satellite/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const parcel = new ol.source.Vector();
const outline = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#ffd400', width: 3 }), fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color: 'rgba(255, 212, 0, 0.15)' }) });
const label = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
label.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: label, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -8] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: parcel, style: outline })], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([15.3306, 48.2275]), zoom: 19, maxZoom: 21 }) }); // Melk

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const [lon, lat] = ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate);
  parcel.clear();
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/${lon.toFixed(6)},${lat.toFixed(6)}`, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const f = (await r.json()).features[0]; // GeoJSON polygon of the parcel
    if (f) parcel.addFeature(new ol.format.GeoJSON().readFeature(f, { featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }));
    const p = f?.properties;
    label.textContent = p ? (de ? `Grundstück ${p.parcel_number}, Katastralgemeinde ${p.cadastral_municipality_id}` : `Parcel ${p.parcel_number}, cadastral municipality ${p.cadastral_municipality_id}`) : (de ? 'Kein Grundstück an dieser Stelle.' : 'No parcel at this point.');
  } catch (err) { label.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
  popup.setPosition(e.coordinate);
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Cadastre: a click asks the Parcel API for the parcel at that point, draws its outline and shows parcel number and cadastral municipality.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = 'Orthophoto: <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://basemap.at">basemap.at</a>; BEV – DKM; <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2275, 15.3306], 19); // Melk
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/satellite/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const parcel = L.geoJSON(null, { style: { color: '#ffd400', weight: 3, fillOpacity: 0.15 } }).addTo(map);

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const { lng, lat } = e.latlng;
  parcel.clearLayers();
  let text;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/${lng.toFixed(6)},${lat.toFixed(6)}`, AUTH);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const f = (await r.json()).features[0]; // GeoJSON polygon of the parcel
    if (f) parcel.addData(f);
    const p = f?.properties;
    text = p ? (de ? `Grundstück ${p.parcel_number}, Katastralgemeinde ${p.cadastral_municipality_id}` : `Parcel ${p.parcel_number}, cadastral municipality ${p.cadastral_municipality_id}`) : (de ? 'Kein Grundstück an dieser Stelle.' : 'No parcel at this point.');
  } catch (err) { text = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
  L.popup().setLatLng(e.latlng).setContent(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: text })).openOn(map); // as text, not HTML
});
````

# TileJSON-Quellen: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/tilejson-source/

> Orthophoto und Höhenlinien von mapx als TileJSON-Quellen ohne fertigen Stil in MapLibre GL JS einbinden: lauffähiger Beispielcode zum Kopieren.

Eine TileJSON-URL pro Produkt genügt: MapLibre liest Kachel-URL, Zoombereich und Attribution daraus. Hier ein eigener, minimaler Stil. OpenLayers liest das TileJSON nicht selbst: Die OpenLayers-Fassung lädt es per `fetch` und baut daraus `ol.source.XYZ` (Raster) und `ol.source.VectorTile` mit `ol.format.MVT` (Vektorkacheln).

## Code

Leaflet zeigt nur den Rasterteil: Vektorkacheln kann es ohne Plugin nicht, die Höhenlinien fehlen dort.

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Use TileJSON: orthophoto and contour lines as sources, without file names and without a style.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  attributionControl: false,
  transformRequest,
  container: 'map', center: [11.4, 47.27], zoom: 12.5, // Innsbruck
  style: {
    version: 8,
    sources: {
      ortho: { type: 'raster', url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/orthophoto.json', tileSize: 512 },
      linien: { type: 'vector', url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/contours.json' },
    },
    layers: [
      { id: 'ortho', type: 'raster', source: 'ortho' },
      { id: 'linien', type: 'line', source: 'linien', 'source-layer': 'contour_l', paint: { 'line-color': '#ffd24a', 'line-width': 0.8, 'line-opacity': 0.9 } },
    ],
  },
});
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Use TileJSON: orthophoto (raster) and contour lines (vector tiles, MVT) as sources, without file names and without a style.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; this example takes the text from each TileJSON.

const linie = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: 'rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.9)', width: 0.8 }) });
const ortho = new ol.layer.Tile(), linien = new ol.layer.VectorTile({ style: linie });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [ortho, linien], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([11.4, 47.27]), zoom: 13.5 }) }); // Innsbruck

const plain = (html) => new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html').body.textContent; // attribution as text, not as HTML
async function tilejson(name) {
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/${name}.json`, AUTH);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
  const tj = await r.json(); // tile URL, zoom range and attribution
  return { url: tj.tiles[0] + '?access_token=' + TOKEN, minZoom: tj.minzoom, maxZoom: tj.maxzoom, attributions: plain(tj.attribution ?? ''), attributionsCollapsible: false };
}
(async () => {
  ortho.setSource(new ol.source.XYZ({ ...(await tilejson('orthophoto')), tileSize: 512 }));
  linien.setSource(new ol.source.VectorTile({ ...(await tilejson('contours')), format: new ol.format.MVT({ layers: ['contour_l'] }) }));
})();
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Use TileJSON: the orthophoto as a raster source, tile URL, zoom range and attribution come from the TileJSON.
// Leaflet has no vector tiles without a plugin, so the contour lines of the MapLibre version are missing here.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };

const map = L.map('map').setView([47.27, 11.4], 14); // Innsbruck
(async () => {
  const tj = await (await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/orthophoto.json', AUTH)).json();
  // the attribution text of the TileJSON (CC BY 4.0) must stay visible on the map; escaped, as it is API text, not HTML
  L.tileLayer(tj.tiles[0] + '?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: tj.minzoom + 1, maxNativeZoom: tj.maxzoom + 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: tj.attribution }).innerHTML }).addTo(map);
})();
````

Leaflet liest kein TileJSON von selbst: Die Leaflet-Fassung holt es mit `fetch` und übernimmt `tiles`, `minzoom`, `maxzoom` und `attribution`, zeigt aber nur das Orthophoto, denn Vektorkacheln wie die Höhenlinien kann Leaflet ohne Plugin nicht.

## Verwendete APIs

- [TileJSON](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/tiles.md) `orthophoto`, `contours`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (Leaflet)

# 3D-Gebäude: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/buildings-3d/

> Extrudierte 3D-Gebäude mit BEV-Höhen auf der mapx-Vektor-Basiskarte, Kamera geneigt, in MapLibre GL JS. Lauffähiger Code zum Kopieren.

Der Stil `streets` enthält eine extrudierte Gebäudeebene, die standardmäßig aus ist. Die Ebenen-IDs stehen in den Style-Metadaten (`mapx:groups`), damit lässt sich eine ganze Gruppe einschalten, ohne die Namen zu kennen. Auf Zoom 15 oder höher gehen und die Karte kippen (rechte Maustaste oder zwei Finger).

## Code

3D-Gebäude gibt es nur in MapLibre; OpenLayers und Leaflet zeichnen flache Karten.

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// 3D buildings: switch on the extruded building layer of the streets style and tilt the camera.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 16.2, pitch: 62, bearing: -20 }); // Stephansplatz, Vienna
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)

map.on('style.load', () => {
  // The style lists its layer groups in the metadata, so no layer names are hard-coded.
  for (const id of map.getStyle().metadata['mapx:groups'].buildings3d) map.setLayoutProperty(id, 'visibility', 'visible');
});
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Styles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}`

# Search Box: Beispiel mit Vorschlägen

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/search-box/

> Vorschläge beim Tippen, Position nach dem Klick und Typfilter: Suche mit Autovervollständigung über die mapx-Search-Box-API, lauffähiger Code.

Die Search Box arbeitet in zwei Schritten: `suggest` liefert Vorschläge beim Tippen, `retrieve` die Position des gewählten. Für beide Aufrufe dasselbe `session_token` verwenden, für die nächste Suche ein neues. Der Typfilter begrenzt die Vorschläge.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Search Box: suggestions while typing (suggest), position and details after the click (retrieve). One session token per search.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [14.3, 47.6], zoom: 7 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const input = document.getElementById('q'), types = document.getElementById('types'), list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker, token = crypto.randomUUID();

input.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  list.replaceChildren();
  if (input.value.trim().length < 2) return;
  const c = map.getCenter();
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}&session_token=${token}&proximity=${c.lng},${c.lat}&limit=6` + (types.value ? `&types=${types.value}` : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    for (const s of (await res.json()).suggestions) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = `${s.name} (${s.feature_type}) ${s.place_formatted ?? ''}`;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => pick(s.mapbox_id));
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});

async function pick(id) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?session_token=${token}`, AUTH);
  const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
  marker?.remove();
  marker = new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(f.geometry.coordinates).addTo(map);
  map.flyTo({ center: f.geometry.coordinates, zoom: f.properties.zoom ?? 15 });
  list.replaceChildren();
  token = crypto.randomUUID(); // the session ends with retrieve
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Search Box: suggestions while typing (suggest), position and details after the click (retrieve). One session token per search.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const hit = new ol.source.Vector(); // the chosen result
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: hit, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([14.3, 47.6]), zoom: 8 }) });
const input = document.getElementById('q'), types = document.getElementById('types'), list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let token = crypto.randomUUID();

input.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  list.replaceChildren();
  if (input.value.trim().length < 2) return;
  const [lon, lat] = ol.proj.toLonLat(map.getView().getCenter());
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}&session_token=${token}&proximity=${lon},${lat}&limit=6` + (types.value ? `&types=${types.value}` : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    for (const s of (await res.json()).suggestions) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = `${s.name} (${s.feature_type}) ${s.place_formatted ?? ''}`;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => pick(s.mapbox_id));
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});

async function pick(id) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?session_token=${token}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    const at = ol.proj.fromLonLat(f.geometry.coordinates);
    hit.clear();
    hit.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(at)));
    map.getView().animate({ center: at, zoom: (f.properties.zoom ?? 15) + 1 });
    list.replaceChildren();
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
  token = crypto.randomUUID(); // the session ends with retrieve
}
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Search Box: suggestions while typing (suggest), position and details after the click (retrieve). One session token per search.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the search (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([47.6, 14.3], 8);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const input = document.getElementById('q'), types = document.getElementById('types'), list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker, token = crypto.randomUUID();
input.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  list.replaceChildren();
  if (input.value.trim().length < 2) return;
  const c = map.getCenter();
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}&session_token=${token}&proximity=${c.lng},${c.lat}&limit=6` + (types.value ? `&types=${types.value}` : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    for (const s of (await res.json()).suggestions) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = `${s.name} (${s.feature_type}) ${s.place_formatted ?? ''}`;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => pick(s.mapbox_id));
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
async function pick(id) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?session_token=${token}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    const [lng, lat] = f.geometry.coordinates;
    marker?.remove();
    marker = L.circleMarker([lat, lng], { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(map);
    map.flyTo([lat, lng], (f.properties.zoom ?? 15) + 1);
    list.replaceChildren();
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
  token = crypto.randomUUID(); // the session ends with retrieve
}
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Search Box](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/search-box.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest`
- [Search Box](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/search-box.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/{id}`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Adress-Autofill im Formular: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/autofill/

> Straße tippen, Vorschlag wählen, die Formularfelder füllen sich: Adress-Autofill für österreichische Adressen mit der mapx-Autofill-API. Lauffähiger Code.

Autofill ist für Bestell- und Anmeldeformulare gedacht: ein Textfeld, eine Vorschlagsliste, und die übrigen Felder (Hausnummer, PLZ, Ort) werden aus dem gewählten Vorschlag gefüllt. Jeder Vorschlag bringt seine Koordinaten schon mit.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Address autofill: type a street and number, pick a suggestion, the form fields fill themselves.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [13.8, 47.7], zoom: 6.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const f = Object.fromEntries(['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place'].map((k) => [k, document.getElementById(k)]));
const list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker;

f.street.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  list.replaceChildren();
  if (f.street.value.trim().length < 3) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(f.street.value)}&limit=5&session_token=demo`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    for (const s of (await res.json()).suggestions) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = s.full_address;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        for (const k of Object.keys(f)) f[k].value = s[k] ?? '';
        marker?.remove();
        marker = new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(s.coordinates).addTo(map);
        map.flyTo({ center: s.coordinates, zoom: 16 });
        list.replaceChildren();
      });
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Address autofill: type a street and number, pick a suggestion, the form fields fill themselves.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const hit = new ol.source.Vector(); // the chosen address
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: hit, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([13.8, 47.7]), zoom: 7.5 }) });
const f = Object.fromEntries(['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place'].map((k) => [k, document.getElementById(k)]));
const list = document.getElementById('treffer');

f.street.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  list.replaceChildren();
  if (f.street.value.trim().length < 3) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(f.street.value)}&limit=5&session_token=demo`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    for (const s of (await res.json()).suggestions) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = s.full_address;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        for (const k of Object.keys(f)) f[k].value = s[k] ?? '';
        const at = ol.proj.fromLonLat(s.coordinates);
        hit.clear();
        hit.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(at)));
        map.getView().animate({ center: at, zoom: 17 });
        list.replaceChildren();
      });
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Address autofill: type a street and number, pick a suggestion, the form fields fill themselves.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the addresses (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const f = Object.fromEntries(['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place'].map((k) => [k, document.getElementById(k)]));
const list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker;
f.street.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  list.replaceChildren();
  if (f.street.value.trim().length < 3) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(f.street.value)}&limit=5&session_token=demo`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    for (const s of (await res.json()).suggestions) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = s.full_address;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        for (const k of Object.keys(f)) f[k].value = s[k] ?? '';
        const [lng, lat] = s.coordinates;
        marker?.remove();
        marker = L.circleMarker([lat, lng], { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(map);
        map.flyTo([lat, lng], 17);
        list.replaceChildren();
      });
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Adressen](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/address.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Adressvalidierung: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/address-validation/

> Eine Adresse mit der Adressvalidierungs-API gegen das amtliche österreichische Adressregister prüfen und das korrigierte Ergebnis zeigen. Lauffähiger Code.

Die Validierung gleicht die vier Adressteile mit dem Adressregister des BEV ab. Das Ergebnis hat einen `status` (`match`, `corrected`, `ambiguous`, `not_found`), die Liste der `deviations` und entweder die passende `address` mit Koordinaten oder eine Liste von `candidates`. Die vorbelegte Adresse enthält absichtlich einen Tippfehler.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Address validation: check a typed address against the official register (BEV) and show the corrected result.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [13.8, 47.7], zoom: 6.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const out = document.getElementById('ergebnis');
let marker;

document.getElementById('pruefen').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const k of ['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place']) p.set(k, document.getElementById(k).value);
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?' + p, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const r = await res.json(); // status: match, corrected, ambiguous, not_found
    const hit = r.address ? { text: r.address.full_address, at: r.coordinates } : r.candidates?.[0] && { text: r.candidates[0].full_address, at: r.candidates[0].coordinates };
    out.textContent = `Status: ${r.status}` + (r.deviations?.length ? `, ${de ? 'Abweichungen' : 'deviations'}: ${r.deviations.map((d) => `${d.field} ${d.input} > ${d.expected}`).join('; ')}` : '') + (hit ? `, ${r.address ? (de ? 'Adresse' : 'address') : (de ? 'erster Kandidat' : 'first candidate')}: ${hit.text}` : '');
    marker?.remove();
    if (hit) { marker = new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(hit.at).addTo(map); map.flyTo({ center: hit.at, zoom: 16 }); }
  } catch (e) { out.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html

```

````js
// Address validation: check a typed address against the official register (BEV) and show the corrected result.

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });

const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: hit, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([13.8, 47.7]), zoom: 7.5 }) });

document.getElementById('pruefen').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const k of ['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place']) p.set(k, document.getElementById(k).value);
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?' + p, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const r = await res.json(); // status: match, corrected, ambiguous, not_found
    const top = r.address ? { text: r.address.full_address, at: r.coordinates } : r.candidates?.[0] && { text: r.candidates[0].full_address, at: r.candidates[0].coordinates };
    out.textContent = `Status: ${r.status}` + (r.deviations?.length ? `, ${de ? 'Abweichungen' : 'deviations'}: ${r.deviations.map((d) => `${d.field} ${d.input} > ${d.expected}`).join('; ')}` : '') + (top ? `, ${r.address ? (de ? 'Adresse' : 'address') : (de ? 'erster Kandidat' : 'first candidate')}: ${top.text}` : '');
    hit.clear();
    if (top) { hit.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(ol.proj.fromLonLat(top.at)))); map.getView().animate({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat(top.at), zoom: 17 }); }
  } catch (e) { out.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

````js
  } catch (e) { out.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
````

# Reverse Geocoding: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/reverse-geocode/

> Karte anklicken und die nächste Adresse erhalten: Reverse Geocoding mit der mapx-Geocoding-API für Österreich, lauffähiger Code mit MapLibre GL JS.

Reverse Geocoding macht aus einer Koordinate die nächste Adresse, Straße oder den nächsten Ort. `types` begrenzt die Art des Ergebnisses, `radius` die Suchdistanz in Metern.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Reverse geocoding: click the map, get the nearest address, street or place.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 15 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const popup = new maplibregl.Popup({ closeButton: false });

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const { lng, lat } = e.lngLat;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=${lng}&lat=${lat}&limit=1&types=address,street,place`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText(f ? f.place_name : (de ? 'In der Nähe nichts gefunden' : 'Nothing found nearby')).addTo(map);
  } catch (err) { popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText((de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message).addTo(map); }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Reverse geocoding: click the map, get the nearest address, street or place.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const label = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
label.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: label, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -8] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([16.3725, 48.2085]), zoom: 16 }) }); // Stephansplatz, Vienna

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const [lng, lat] = ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=${lng}&lat=${lat}&limit=1&types=address,street,place`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    label.textContent = f ? f.place_name : (de ? 'In der Nähe nichts gefunden' : 'Nothing found nearby');
  } catch (err) { label.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
  popup.setPosition(e.coordinate);
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Reverse geocoding: click the map, get the nearest address, street or place.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the addresses (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2085, 16.3725], 16);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const popup = L.popup({ closeButton: false });
const show = (latlng, s) => popup.setLatLng(latlng).setContent(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: s })).openOn(map); // as text, not HTML
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const { lng, lat } = e.latlng;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=${lng}&lat=${lat}&limit=1&types=address,street,place`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    show(e.latlng, f ? f.place_name : (de ? 'In der Nähe nichts gefunden' : 'Nothing found nearby'));
  } catch (err) { show(e.latlng, (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message); }
});
````
