# Lkw-Route: Beispiel mit Optionen

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/truck-route/

> Lkw-Routing mit Fahrzeugmaßen, Maut und Autobahn meiden sowie Alternativen: lauffähiges Beispiel für die mapx-Routing-API zum Kopieren.

Das Profil `driving-truck` mit Gewicht und Höhe wählen: Straßen mit passenden Verboten und Beschränkungen werden gemieden, die Antwort nennt die GO-mautpflichtigen Kilometer. Für Pkw (`driving`) lassen sich Maut und Autobahn meiden, dazu gibt es bis zu zwei Alternativen. Start und Ziel anklicken.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Truck route: start and destination by click, vehicle size, avoid tolls and motorways, alternatives in grey.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [15.4, 48.2], zoom: 8 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const pts = [], markers = [];

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('routes', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'routes', type: 'line', source: 'routes', layout: { 'line-cap': 'round' }, paint: { 'line-color': ['case', ['==', ['get', 'main'], 1], '#2346d8', '#9aa4b8'], 'line-width': ['case', ['==', ['get', 'main'], 1], 6, 4] } });
});
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.splice(0).forEach((m) => m.remove()); }
  pts.push([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]);
  markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({ color: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).addTo(map));
  if (pts.length === 2) route();
});
for (const id of ['profile', 'toll', 'motorway', 'weight', 'height']) $(id).addEventListener('change', () => pts.length === 2 && route());

async function route() {
  const profile = $('profile').value, q = new URLSearchParams({ overview: 'full', geometries: 'geojson', alternatives: 'true' });
  if (profile === 'driving-truck') { q.set('weight', $('weight').value); q.set('height', $('height').value); q.delete('alternatives'); }
  const exclude = ['toll', 'motorway'].filter((k) => $(k).checked);
  if (profile === 'driving' && exclude.length) q.set('exclude', exclude.join(','));
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/${profile}/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?${q}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { routes } = await res.json();
    map.getSource('routes').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: routes.map((r, i) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { main: i === 0 ? 1 : 0 }, geometry: r.geometry })).reverse() });
    const r = routes[0];
    $('info').textContent = `${(r.distance / 1000).toFixed(1)} km, ${Math.round(r.duration / 60)} min` + (r.toll?.truck_go_km != null ? `, ${r.toll.truck_go_km.toFixed(1)} km ${de ? 'GO-mautpflichtig' : 'subject to GO toll'}` : '') + (routes.length > 1 ? `, ${routes.length - 1} ${de ? 'Alternative(n)' : 'alternative(s)'}` : '');
  } catch (err) { $('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Truck route: start and destination by click, vehicle size, avoid tolls and motorways, alternatives in grey.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, Maut: ASFINAG, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const routes = new ol.source.Vector(), points = new ol.source.Vector();
const style = (f) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: f.get('main'), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: f.get('main') ? '#2346d8' : '#9aa4b8', width: f.get('main') ? 6 : 4, lineCap: 'round' }) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: routes, style }), new ol.layer.Vector({ source: points })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([15.4, 48.2]), zoom: 9 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const pts = [];

map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; points.clear(); routes.clear(); }
  pts.push(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate));
  const m = new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(e.coordinate));
  m.setStyle(pin(pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d'));
  points.addFeature(m);
  if (pts.length === 2) route();
});
for (const id of ['profile', 'toll', 'motorway', 'weight', 'height']) $(id).addEventListener('change', () => pts.length === 2 && route());

async function route() {
  const profile = $('profile').value, q = new URLSearchParams({ overview: 'full', geometries: 'geojson', alternatives: 'true' });
  if (profile === 'driving-truck') { q.set('weight', $('weight').value); q.set('height', $('height').value); q.delete('alternatives'); }
  const exclude = ['toll', 'motorway'].filter((k) => $(k).checked);
  if (profile === 'driving' && exclude.length) q.set('exclude', exclude.join(','));
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/${profile}/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?${q}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { routes: list } = await res.json();
    routes.clear();
    routes.addFeatures(list.map((r, i) => { const f = geojson.readFeature(r.geometry); f.set('main', i === 0 ? 1 : 0); return f; }));
    const r = list[0];
    $('info').textContent = `${(r.distance / 1000).toFixed(1)} km, ${Math.round(r.duration / 60)} min` + (r.toll?.truck_go_km != null ? `, ${r.toll.truck_go_km.toFixed(1)} km ${de ? 'GO-mautpflichtig' : 'subject to GO toll'}` : '') + (list.length > 1 ? `, ${list.length - 1} ${de ? 'Alternative(n)' : 'alternative(s)'}` : '');
  } catch (err) { $('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Truck route: start and destination by click, vehicle size, avoid tolls and motorways, alternatives in grey.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style, the routing and the toll data (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, Maut: ASFINAG, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2, 15.4], 9);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const lines = L.geoJSON(null, { style: (f) => (f.properties.main ? { color: '#2346d8', weight: 6, opacity: 1 } : { color: '#9aa4b8', weight: 4, opacity: 1 }) }).addTo(map);
const markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const pts = [];
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.clearLayers(); lines.clearLayers(); }
  pts.push([e.latlng.lng, e.latlng.lat]);
  L.circleMarker(e.latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(markers);
  if (pts.length === 2) route();
});
for (const id of ['profile', 'toll', 'motorway', 'weight', 'height']) $(id).addEventListener('change', () => pts.length === 2 && route());
async function route() {
  const profile = $('profile').value, q = new URLSearchParams({ overview: 'full', geometries: 'geojson', alternatives: 'true' });
  if (profile === 'driving-truck') { q.set('weight', $('weight').value); q.set('height', $('height').value); q.delete('alternatives'); }
  const exclude = ['toll', 'motorway'].filter((k) => $(k).checked);
  if (profile === 'driving' && exclude.length) q.set('exclude', exclude.join(','));
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/${profile}/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?${q}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { routes } = await res.json();
    lines.clearLayers();
    // alternatives first, the main route last so it is drawn on top
    lines.addData(routes.map((r, i) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { main: i === 0 }, geometry: r.geometry })).reverse());
    const r = routes[0];
    $('info').textContent = `${(r.distance / 1000).toFixed(1)} km, ${Math.round(r.duration / 60)} min` + (r.toll?.truck_go_km != null ? `, ${r.toll.truck_go_km.toFixed(1)} km ${de ? 'GO-mautpflichtig' : 'subject to GO toll'}` : '') + (routes.length > 1 ? `, ${routes.length - 1} ${de ? 'Alternative(n)' : 'alternative(s)'}` : '');
  } catch (err) { $('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Tourenplanung: Beispiel Stopp-Reihenfolge

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/optimization/

> Haltestellen auf der Karte anklicken und die beste Reihenfolge ab Depot und zurück mit der mapx-Routenoptimierung erhalten: lauffähiges Beispiel.

Die Optimization-API ordnet Stopps für ein oder mehrere Fahrzeuge, mit Servicezeiten, Kapazitäten und Zeitfenstern. Hier startet und endet ein Fahrzeug in Melk. Bis zu neun Stopps anklicken, jeder Klick plant neu. Die Reihenfolge wird mit einer Directions-Anfrage durch alle Stopps gezeichnet.

`POST /v1/optimization` geht nur mit einem geheimen Token (`mx_sk_…`); ein öffentlicher Token bekommt `403 pk-not-allowed`. In der eigenen Anwendung die Anfrage daher über den eigenen Server schicken, nicht direkt aus der Webseite.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Tour planning: click stops (up to 9), the optimization API finds the shortest order from the depot and back.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
// Note: POST needs a secret token (mx_sk_…), public tokens are read-only. Run this call from your server, not from a web page.
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const depot = [15.3294, 48.2272]; // Melk
const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: depot, zoom: 9 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const stops = [], markers = [];
let timer;
new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#222' }).setLngLat(depot).addTo(map);

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('tour', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'tour', type: 'line', source: 'tour', layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' }, paint: { 'line-color': '#2346d8', 'line-width': 5 } });
});
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (stops.length >= 9) return;
  stops.push([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]);
  markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#c8372d' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).addTo(map));
  clearTimeout(timer); // plan once after the last click
  if (stops.length >= 2) timer = setTimeout(plan, 600);
});
document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
  stops.length = 0; markers.splice(0).forEach((m) => m.remove());
  map.getSource('tour').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] });
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = de ? 'Mindestens zwei Stopps anklicken.' : 'Click at least two stops.';
});

async function plan() {
  const body = { vehicles: [{ id: 1, start: depot, end: depot }], services: stops.map((location, i) => ({ id: i + 1, location, service: 300 })) };
  try {
    let res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization', { method: 'POST', headers: { ...AUTH.headers, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const tour = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    const order = tour.steps.map((s) => s.location);
    // The tour only lists the order; draw the roads with one directions request through all stops.
    res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/driving/${order.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?overview=full&geometries=geojson`, AUTH);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    map.getSource('tour').setData({ type: 'Feature', geometry: route.geometry, properties: {} });
    document.getElementById('info').textContent = `${de ? 'Reihenfolge' : 'Order'}: ${tour.steps.filter((s) => s.type === 'job').map((s) => s.id).join(' > ')}, ${(tour.distance / 1000).toFixed(0)} km, ${Math.round(tour.duration / 60)} min ${de ? 'Fahrzeit' : 'driving'}`;
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Tour planning: click stops (up to 9), the optimization API finds the shortest order from the depot and back.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Note: POST needs a secret token (mx_sk_…), public tokens are read-only. Run this call from your server, not from a web page.
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const depot = [15.3294, 48.2272]; // Melk
const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const tour = new ol.source.Vector(), points = new ol.source.Vector();
const line = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#2346d8', width: 5, lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round' }) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: tour, style: line }), new ol.layer.Vector({ source: points, style: pin('#c8372d') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat(depot), zoom: 10 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const depotMarker = new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(ol.proj.fromLonLat(depot)));
depotMarker.setStyle(pin('#222'));
const stops = [];
let timer;
points.addFeature(depotMarker);

map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (stops.length >= 9) return;
  stops.push(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate));
  points.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(e.coordinate)));
  clearTimeout(timer); // plan once after the last click
  if (stops.length >= 2) timer = setTimeout(plan, 600);
});
document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
  stops.length = 0; points.clear(); points.addFeature(depotMarker); tour.clear();
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = de ? 'Mindestens zwei Stopps anklicken.' : 'Click at least two stops.';
});

async function plan() {
  const body = { vehicles: [{ id: 1, start: depot, end: depot }], services: stops.map((location, i) => ({ id: i + 1, location, service: 300 })) };
  try {
    let res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization', { method: 'POST', headers: { ...AUTH.headers, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const plan = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    const order = plan.steps.map((s) => s.location);
    // The tour only lists the order; draw the roads with one directions request through all stops.
    res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/driving/${order.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?overview=full&geometries=geojson`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    tour.clear();
    tour.addFeature(geojson.readFeature((await res.json()).routes[0].geometry));
    document.getElementById('info').textContent = `${de ? 'Reihenfolge' : 'Order'}: ${plan.steps.filter((s) => s.type === 'job').map((s) => s.id).join(' > ')}, ${(plan.distance / 1000).toFixed(0)} km, ${Math.round(plan.duration / 60)} min ${de ? 'Fahrzeit' : 'driving'}`;
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

````js
// Tour planning: click stops (up to 9), the optimization API finds the shortest order from the depot and back.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };

  const body = { vehicles: [{ id: 1, start: depot, end: depot }], services: stops.map((location, i) => ({ id: i + 1, location, service: 300 })) };
  try {
    let res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization', { method: 'POST', headers: { ...AUTH.headers, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
````

# ÖV-Verbindung: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/transit-route/

> Start und Ziel anklicken und die Fuß- und Fahrabschnitte einer ÖV-Verbindung in Österreich mit der mapx-ÖV-API erhalten; lauffähiger Code.

Die Transit-API kombiniert Fußwege auf dem Wegenetz mit Fahrten aus dem Fahrplan. Ohne `depart_at` wird für jetzt geplant, `arrive_by` plant rückwärts. Fußabschnitte sind gestrichelt gezeichnet, Fahrten durchgezogen.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Public transit: click start and destination, get walking and riding legs for the next departure.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 12 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const pts = [], markers = [];

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('legs', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  const line = { 'line-width': 5 };
  map.addLayer({ id: 'legs-ride', type: 'line', source: 'legs', filter: ['!=', ['get', 'mode'], 'walking'], layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' }, paint: { ...line, 'line-color': '#2346d8' } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'legs-walk', type: 'line', source: 'legs', filter: ['==', ['get', 'mode'], 'walking'], layout: { 'line-join': 'round' }, paint: { ...line, 'line-color': '#667', 'line-dasharray': [1, 1.5] } });
});
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.splice(0).forEach((m) => m.remove()); }
  pts.push([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]);
  markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({ color: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).addTo(map));
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  const info = document.getElementById('info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?routes=1`, AUTH); // add depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00 for a fixed time
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    map.getSource('legs').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: route.legs.map((l) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { mode: l.mode }, geometry: l.geometry })) });
    info.textContent = `${route.departure.slice(11, 16)} ${de ? 'bis' : 'to'} ${route.arrival.slice(11, 16)}, ${Math.round(route.duration / 60)} min, ${route.transfers} ${de ? 'Umstieg(e)' : 'transfer(s)'}: ` + route.legs.map((l) => l.summary).join(' > ');
  } catch (err) { info.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Public transit: click start and destination, get walking and riding legs for the next departure.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>; Fahrplan/timetable: ÖBB-Personenverkehr AG, Mobilitätsverbünde Österreich OG; <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const legs = new ol.source.Vector(), points = new ol.source.Vector();
const ride = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#2346d8', width: 5, lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round' }) });
const walk = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#667', width: 5, lineJoin: 'round', lineDash: [5, 7.5] }) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: legs, style: (f) => (f.get('mode') === 'walking' ? walk : ride) }), new ol.layer.Vector({ source: points })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([16.3725, 48.2085]), zoom: 13 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const pts = [];

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; points.clear(); legs.clear(); }
  pts.push(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate));
  const m = new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(e.coordinate));
  m.setStyle(pin(pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d'));
  points.addFeature(m);
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  const info = document.getElementById('info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?routes=1`, AUTH); // add depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00 for a fixed time
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    legs.addFeatures(route.legs.map((l) => { const f = geojson.readFeature(l.geometry); f.set('mode', l.mode); return f; }));
    info.textContent = `${route.departure.slice(11, 16)} ${de ? 'bis' : 'to'} ${route.arrival.slice(11, 16)}, ${Math.round(route.duration / 60)} min, ${route.transfers} ${de ? 'Umstieg(e)' : 'transfer(s)'}: ` + route.legs.map((l) => l.summary).join(' > ');
  } catch (err) { info.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Public transit: click start and destination, get walking and riding legs for the next departure.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the timetables, must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>; Fahrplan: ÖBB-Personenverkehr AG (CC BY 4.0), Mobilitätsverbünde Österreich OG';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2085, 16.3725], 13);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
// riding legs solid blue, walking legs dashed grey
const legs = L.geoJSON(null, { style: (f) => (f.properties.mode === 'walking' ? { color: '#667', weight: 5, opacity: 1, dashArray: '5 8' } : { color: '#2346d8', weight: 5, opacity: 1 }) }).addTo(map);
const markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const pts = [];
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.clearLayers(); legs.clearLayers(); }
  pts.push([e.latlng.lng, e.latlng.lat]);
  L.circleMarker(e.latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(markers);
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  const info = document.getElementById('info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?routes=1`, AUTH); // add depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00 for a fixed time
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    legs.addData(route.legs.map((l) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { mode: l.mode }, geometry: l.geometry })));
    info.textContent = `${route.departure.slice(11, 16)} ${de ? 'bis' : 'to'} ${route.arrival.slice(11, 16)}, ${Math.round(route.duration / 60)} min, ${route.transfers} ${de ? 'Umstieg(e)' : 'transfer(s)'}: ` + route.legs.map((l) => l.summary).join(' > ');
  } catch (err) { info.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Abfahrten an einer Haltestelle: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/departures/

> Nahe an eine ÖV-Haltestelle in Österreich klicken und die nächsten Abfahrten sehen: ÖV-Abfahrts-API mit Live-Karte und lauffähigem Code.

Ein Klick sucht über `/v1/stops` die nächste Haltestelle im Umkreis von 150 m und listet über `/v1/departures` die nächsten Abfahrten aus dem Soll-Fahrplan (keine Echtzeitdaten). Die Punkte sind die Haltestellen im sichtbaren Ausschnitt aus `/v1/stops`.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Departures: click near a stop to see the next departures (/v1/stops finds the stop, /v1/departures lists the departures).
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
const api = async (path) => { const r = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1' + path, AUTH); if (!r.ok) throw new Error((await r.json()).title || r.statusText); return r.json(); };

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 15.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const popup = new maplibregl.Popup({ maxWidth: '340px' });

// Show the stops of the visible area as dots.
map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('stops', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'stops', type: 'circle', source: 'stops', paint: { 'circle-radius': 6, 'circle-color': '#2346d8', 'circle-stroke-color': '#fff', 'circle-stroke-width': 2 } });
  const load = async () => {
    const b = map.getBounds();
    const { stops } = await api(`/stops?bbox=${[b.getWest(), b.getSouth(), b.getEast(), b.getNorth()].map((v) => v.toFixed(5)).join(',')}&limit=100`);
    map.getSource('stops').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: stops.map((s) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name: s.name }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: s.location } })) });
  };
  map.on('moveend', load);
  load();
});

// A click finds the nearest stop within 150 m and lists its next 8 departures (timetable, no real-time data).
let seq = 0;
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const n = ++seq, at = `${e.lngLat.lng.toFixed(6)},${e.lngLat.lat.toFixed(6)}`;
  popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText(de ? 'Lade …' : 'Loading …').addTo(map);
  try {
    const stop = (await api(`/stops?near=${at}&radius=150&limit=1`)).stops[0];
    if (!stop) { popup.setText(de ? 'Keine Haltestelle in 150 m' : 'No stop within 150 m'); return; }
    const { departures } = await api(`/departures?stop=${encodeURIComponent(stop.id)}&limit=8`);
    if (n !== seq) return; // a newer click has taken over
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('strong'), { textContent: stop.name }));
    if (!departures.length) el.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { textContent: de ? 'Keine Abfahrten' : 'No departures' }));
    for (const d of departures) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('b'), { textContent: d.time.slice(11, 16) }), ` ${d.line.name} → ${d.headsign}`);
      el.append(row);
    }
    popup.setLngLat(stop.location).setDOMContent(el);
  } catch (err) { if (n === seq) popup.setText(err.message); }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Departures: the stops of the visible area from /v1/stops; click a stop (or near one) for the next departures from /v1/departures.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>; Fahrplan/timetable: ÖBB-Personenverkehr AG, Mobilitätsverbünde Österreich OG; <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const stops = new ol.source.Vector();
const dot = new ol.style.Style({ image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 6, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color: '#2346d8' }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const box = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
box.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006;max-width:280px';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: box, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -10] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: stops, style: dot })], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([16.3725, 48.2085]), zoom: 16.5 }) }); // Stephansplatz, Vienna

map.on('moveend', async () => {
  const [w, s, e, n] = ol.proj.transformExtent(map.getView().calculateExtent(map.getSize()), 'EPSG:3857', 'EPSG:4326');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/stops?bbox=${w},${s},${e},${n}&limit=100`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    stops.clear();
    stops.addFeatures((await res.json()).stops.map((st) => new ol.Feature({ geometry: new ol.geom.Point(ol.proj.fromLonLat(st.location)), id: st.id })));
  } catch (err) { console.warn(err); }
});

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  // a click on a dot asks for that stop, elsewhere for the stops within 150 m
  const hit = map.forEachFeatureAtPixel(e.pixel, (f) => f);
  const stop = hit ? hit.get('id') : ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate).map((v) => v.toFixed(6)).join(',');
  const title = document.createElement('strong');
  box.replaceChildren(title);
  popup.setPosition(hit ? hit.getGeometry().getCoordinates() : e.coordinate);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/departures?stop=${encodeURIComponent(stop)}&limit=8&radius=150`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { departures } = await res.json(); // scheduled timetable, no real-time data
    if (!departures.length) { title.textContent = de ? 'Keine Abfahrten in der Nähe' : 'No departures nearby'; return; }
    title.textContent = departures[0].stop.name;
    for (const d of departures) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.textContent = `${d.time.slice(11, 16)}  ${d.line.name}  ${de ? 'nach' : 'to'} ${d.headsign}`; // API texts as text, never as HTML
      box.append(row);
    }
  } catch (err) { title.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Departures: click near a stop to see the next departures (/v1/stops finds the stop, /v1/departures lists the departures).
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the timetables, must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>; Fahrplan: ÖBB-Personenverkehr AG (CC BY 4.0), Mobilitätsverbünde Österreich OG';
const api = async (path) => { const r = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1' + path, AUTH); if (!r.ok) throw new Error((await r.json()).title || r.statusText); return r.json(); };
const text = (s) => Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: s }); // popup content as text, not HTML

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2085, 16.3725], 16); // Wien, Stephansplatz
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const popup = L.popup({ maxWidth: 340 });

// Show the stops of the visible area as dots.
const dots = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
async function load() {
  const b = map.getBounds();
  const { stops } = await api(`/stops?bbox=${[b.getWest(), b.getSouth(), b.getEast(), b.getNorth()].map((v) => v.toFixed(5)).join(',')}&limit=100`);
  dots.clearLayers();
  for (const s of stops) L.circleMarker([s.location[1], s.location[0]], { radius: 6, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(dots);
}
map.on('moveend', load);
load();

// A click finds the nearest stop within 150 m and lists its next 8 departures (timetable, no real-time data).
let seq = 0;
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const n = ++seq, at = `${e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6)},${e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6)}`;
  popup.setLatLng(e.latlng).setContent(text(de ? 'Lade …' : 'Loading …')).openOn(map);
  try {
    const stop = (await api(`/stops?near=${at}&radius=150&limit=1`)).stops[0];
    if (!stop) { popup.setContent(text(de ? 'Keine Haltestelle in 150 m' : 'No stop within 150 m')); return; }
    const { departures } = await api(`/departures?stop=${encodeURIComponent(stop.id)}&limit=8`);
    if (n !== seq) return; // a newer click has taken over
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('strong'), { textContent: stop.name }));
    if (!departures.length) el.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { textContent: de ? 'Keine Abfahrten' : 'No departures' }));
    for (const d of departures) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('b'), { textContent: d.time.slice(11, 16) }), ` ${d.line.name} → ${d.headsign}`);
      el.append(row);
    }
    popup.setLatLng([stop.location[1], stop.location[0]]).setContent(el);
  } catch (err) { if (n === seq) popup.setContent(text(err.message)); }
});
````

# Verkehrsmeldungen und Sperren: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/traffic/

> Verkehrsstil plus die aktiven Meldungen im sichtbaren Kartenausschnitt: Störungen und Sperren in Österreich mit der mapx-Verkehrs-API.

Der Stil `traffic-day` zeigt die aktuellen Meldungen und färbt auf Autobahnen die Abschnitte, auf denen Wechselverkehrszeichen das Tempo beschränken; eine flächendeckende Verkehrslage gibt es nicht. Meldungen (Unfälle, Baustellen, Sperren) kommen von `/v1/traffic/incidents`; das Beispiel lädt die aktiven für den sichtbaren Ausschnitt und zeichnet sie darüber. Eine Linie anklicken zeigt den Text.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Traffic: the traffic-day style (reports, sign speed limits on motorways) plus the current incident list for the visible area.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/traffic-day', center: [16.2, 48.1], zoom: 9 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const list = document.getElementById('meldungen');
const popup = new maplibregl.Popup();

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('incidents', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'incidents', type: 'line', source: 'incidents', layout: { 'line-cap': 'round' }, paint: { 'line-color': ['case', ['get', 'closed'], '#c8372d', '#e8890c'], 'line-width': 6, 'line-opacity': 0.8 } });
  map.on('click', 'incidents', (e) => popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText(e.features[0].properties.text).addTo(map));
  const load = async () => {
    const b = map.getBounds();
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents?bbox=${b.getWest()},${b.getSouth()},${b.getEast()},${b.getNorth()}&active=true&limit=50`, AUTH);
    const fc = await res.json();
    map.getSource('incidents').setData(fc);
    const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English text
    const first = fc.features[0] ? `${fc.features[0].properties.road ?? ''} ${fc.features[0].properties.type}` : '';
    list.textContent = de
      ? `${fc.features.length} aktive Meldung(en) im Ausschnitt` + (first ? `, z. B. ${first}` : '')
      : `${fc.features.length} active incident(s) in view` + (first ? `, e.g. ${first}` : '');
  };
  map.on('moveend', load);
  load();
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Traffic: the current incident list for the visible area on the street map (the traffic-day style has no raster tiles).
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>; Verkehr/traffic: ASFINAG, EVIS.AT; <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const incidents = new ol.source.Vector();
const style = (f) => new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: f.get('closed') ? 'rgba(200, 55, 45, 0.8)' : 'rgba(232, 137, 12, 0.8)', width: 6, lineCap: 'round' }) });
const label = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
label.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: label, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -8] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: incidents, style })], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([16.2, 48.1]), zoom: 10 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const list = document.getElementById('meldungen');

map.on('click', (e) => {
  const f = map.forEachFeatureAtPixel(e.pixel, (x) => x, { hitTolerance: 4 });
  label.textContent = f?.get('text') ?? '';
  popup.setPosition(f ? e.coordinate : undefined);
});
map.on('moveend', async () => {
  const [w, s, e, n] = ol.proj.transformExtent(map.getView().calculateExtent(map.getSize()), 'EPSG:3857', 'EPSG:4326');
  const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English text
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents?bbox=${w},${s},${e},${n}&active=true&limit=50`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const fc = await res.json();
    incidents.clear();
    incidents.addFeatures(geojson.readFeatures(fc));
    const first = fc.features[0] ? `${fc.features[0].properties.road ?? ''} ${fc.features[0].properties.type}` : '';
    list.textContent = de
      ? `${fc.features.length} aktive Meldung(en) im Ausschnitt` + (first ? `, z. B. ${first}` : '')
      : `${fc.features.length} active incident(s) in view` + (first ? `, e.g. ${first}` : '');
  } catch (err) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Traffic: the current incident list of the visible area as lines over the map, closures in red, a click shows the report.
// The traffic-day style (sign speed limits, traffic layers) has no raster tiles, so the streets style is the basemap here.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the traffic data (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, Verkehr: ASFINAG / EVIS.AT, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.1, 16.2], 10);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const list = document.getElementById('meldungen');
const popup = L.popup();
const incidents = L.geoJSON(null, {
  style: (f) => ({ color: f.properties.closed ? '#c8372d' : '#e8890c', weight: 6, opacity: 0.8, lineCap: 'round' }),
  // a map popup, not one bound to the line: it stays open when moveend reloads the incidents
  onEachFeature: (f, layer) => layer.on('click', (e) => popup.setLatLng(e.latlng).setContent(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: f.properties.text })).openOn(map)), // as text, not HTML
}).addTo(map);
async function load() {
  const b = map.getBounds();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents?bbox=${b.getWest()},${b.getSouth()},${b.getEast()},${b.getNorth()}&active=true&limit=50`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const fc = await res.json();
    incidents.clearLayers().addData(fc);
    const first = fc.features[0] ? `${fc.features[0].properties.road ?? ''} ${fc.features[0].properties.type}` : '';
    list.textContent = de
      ? `${fc.features.length} aktive Meldung(en) im Ausschnitt` + (first ? `, z. B. ${first}` : '')
      : `${fc.features.length} active incident(s) in view` + (first ? `, e.g. ${first}` : '');
  } catch (err) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
map.on('moveend', load);
load();
````

Für `traffic-day` gibt es keine Rasterkacheln; die OpenLayers- und die Leaflet-Fassung zeigen die Meldungen deshalb über dem Stil `streets`, ohne die Tempo-Abschnitte.

## Verwendete APIs

- [Verkehr](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/traffic.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents`
- [Styles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/traffic-day`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Static Image fürs Exposé: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/static-image/

> Ort anklicken und eine fertige Bild-URL einer statischen Karte mit Marker erhalten, etwa fürs Exposé: Static-Images-API, lauffähiger Code.

Ein Static Image ist eine einfache URL, die ein PNG oder WebP liefert: für Exposés, E-Mails, PDFs und Orte ohne JavaScript. Stil, Marker, Ausschnitt und Größe stehen im Pfad. Karte anklicken verschiebt den Marker; das Bild darunter lädt die angezeigte URL.

## Code

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Static image: click the map, get a ready-made PNG of that place for a listing, e-mail or PDF. No JavaScript map needed on the target page.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [15.3294, 48.2272], zoom: 14 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const img = document.getElementById('bild'), style = document.getElementById('style'), url = document.getElementById('url');
let at = [15.3294, 48.2272]; // Melk

function update() {
  const pin = `pin-l+e11d48(${at[0].toFixed(5)},${at[1].toFixed(5)})`;
  const u = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/${style.value}/${encodeURIComponent(pin)}/${at[0].toFixed(5)},${at[1].toFixed(5)},${Math.round(map.getZoom())}/480x300.webp`;
  img.src = u + '?access_token=' + TOKEN; url.textContent = u; // images cannot send headers, so the token goes in the query
}
map.on('click', (e) => { at = [e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]; update(); });
style.addEventListener('change', update);
update();
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Static Images](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/static-images.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/static/{style}/{overlay}/{view}/{size}`

# Eigenes GeoJSON auf der Karte: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/geojson-overlay/

> Eigene GeoJSON-Punkte, -Linie und -Fläche über dem mapx-Stil zeigen, mit Popup per Klick, in MapLibre GL JS. Lauffähiger Code zum Kopieren.

Eigene Daten liegen als GeoJSON-Quelle über dem mapx-Stil. Ein Filter auf den Geometrietyp erlaubt, Punkte, Linien und Flächen getrennt zu gestalten. Größere Datensätze funktionieren genauso als PMTiles. In OpenLayers wählt eine Stilfunktion den Stil je Geometrietyp.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.18.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Own data: add a GeoJSON layer (points, line, area) on top of the mapx style and show a popup on click.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const data = {
  type: 'FeatureCollection',
  features: [
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Stift Melk' : 'Melk Abbey' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [15.3333, 48.2279] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Krems' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [15.6141, 48.4097] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Donauradweg (Abschnitt)' : 'Danube cycle path (section)' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[15.3333, 48.2279], [15.4, 48.3], [15.5, 48.38], [15.6141, 48.4097]] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Wachau (grobe Fläche)' : 'Wachau (rough area)' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[15.3, 48.2], [15.7, 48.35], [15.7, 48.45], [15.4, 48.4], [15.3, 48.2]]] } },
  ],
};
const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [15.45, 48.3], zoom: 9.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('own', { type: 'geojson', data });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'own-area', type: 'fill', source: 'own', filter: ['==', '$type', 'Polygon'], paint: { 'fill-color': '#2346d8', 'fill-opacity': 0.12 } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'own-line', type: 'line', source: 'own', filter: ['==', '$type', 'LineString'], paint: { 'line-color': '#2346d8', 'line-width': 4 } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'own-points', type: 'circle', source: 'own', filter: ['==', '$type', 'Point'], paint: { 'circle-radius': 8, 'circle-color': '#e11d48', 'circle-stroke-color': '#fff', 'circle-stroke-width': 2 } });
  map.on('click', 'own-points', (e) => new maplibregl.Popup().setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText(e.features[0].properties.name).addTo(map));
  map.on('mouseenter', 'own-points', () => (map.getCanvas().style.cursor = 'pointer'));
  map.on('mouseleave', 'own-points', () => (map.getCanvas().style.cursor = ''));
  // PMTiles of your own work the same way: map.addSource('x', { type: 'vector', url: 'pmtiles://https://example.com/x.pmtiles' })
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Own data: add a GeoJSON layer (points, line, area) on top of the mapx map and show a popup on click.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const data = {
  type: 'FeatureCollection',
  features: [
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Stift Melk' : 'Melk Abbey' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [15.3333, 48.2279] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Krems' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [15.6141, 48.4097] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Donauradweg (Abschnitt)' : 'Danube cycle path (section)' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[15.3333, 48.2279], [15.4, 48.3], [15.5, 48.38], [15.6141, 48.4097]] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Wachau (grobe Fläche)' : 'Wachau (rough area)' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[15.3, 48.2], [15.7, 48.35], [15.7, 48.45], [15.4, 48.4], [15.3, 48.2]]] } },
  ],
};
const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const STYLE = {
  Polygon: new ol.style.Style({ fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color: 'rgba(35, 70, 216, 0.12)' }) }),
  LineString: new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#2346d8', width: 4 }) }),
  Point: new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color: '#e11d48' }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) }),
};
const own = new ol.source.Vector({ features: new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }).readFeatures(data) });
const label = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
label.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: label, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -8] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: own, style: (f) => STYLE[f.getGeometry().getType()] })], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([15.45, 48.3]), zoom: 10.5 }) });

const pointAt = (pixel) => map.forEachFeatureAtPixel(pixel, (f) => (f.getGeometry().getType() === 'Point' ? f : undefined));
map.on('click', (e) => {
  const f = pointAt(e.pixel);
  label.textContent = f?.get('name') ?? '';
  popup.setPosition(f?.getGeometry().getCoordinates());
});
map.on('pointermove', (e) => (map.getTargetElement().style.cursor = pointAt(e.pixel) ? 'pointer' : ''));
// Your own vector tiles work the same way: new ol.layer.VectorTile({ source: new ol.source.VectorTile({ format: new ol.format.MVT(), url: 'https://example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf' }) })
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Own data: add a GeoJSON layer (points, line, area) on top of the mapx raster tiles and show a popup on click.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const data = {
  type: 'FeatureCollection',
  features: [
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Stift Melk' : 'Melk Abbey' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [15.3333, 48.2279] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Krems' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [15.6141, 48.4097] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Donauradweg (Abschnitt)' : 'Danube cycle path (section)' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[15.3333, 48.2279], [15.4, 48.3], [15.5, 48.38], [15.6141, 48.4097]] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: de ? 'Wachau (grobe Fläche)' : 'Wachau (rough area)' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[15.3, 48.2], [15.7, 48.35], [15.7, 48.45], [15.4, 48.4], [15.3, 48.2]]] } },
  ],
};
const map = L.map('map').setView([48.3, 15.45], 10);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
L.geoJSON(data, {
  interactive: false, // area and line let clicks through to the points (circles set their own options)
  style: (f) => ({ Polygon: { stroke: false, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 0.12 }, LineString: { color: '#2346d8', weight: 4, opacity: 1 } })[f.geometry.type], // one style per geometry type
  pointToLayer: (f, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#e11d48', fillOpacity: 1 }),
  onEachFeature: (f, layer) => f.geometry.type === 'Point' && layer.bindPopup(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: f.properties.name })), // as text, not HTML
}).addTo(map);
````

In Leaflet übernimmt `L.geoJSON` mit einer `style`-Funktion je Geometrietyp diese Aufgabe, Punkte werden mit `pointToLayer` zu Kreisen.

- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Anwendungsfälle für mapx

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/use-cases/

> Anwendungsfälle für die mapx-Karten und Location-APIs in Österreich: Logistik, Gemeinden, Immobilien und Tourismus, jeweils mit passenden APIs und Code.

---

# Immobilien: Grundstück, Sonne, Exposé

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/use-cases/real-estate/

> Grundstücks-Dossier, Sonne, Hitze und Schnee am Standort, statisches Bild fürs Exposé und Erreichbarkeit einer Adresse, mit Code, der unverändert läuft.

Für ein Exposé braucht es drei Dinge: Fakten zum Grundstück, ein Bild, das die Lage zeigt, und eine Antwort auf „Wie gut ist es erreichbar?“. Alles kommt aus amtlichen offenen Daten (BEV-Kataster, Orthophoto, GIP, Fahrpläne), nutzbar mit einem kostenlosen Token. Die Daten dienen der Orientierung und sind rechtlich nicht verbindlich.

Alle Aufrufe brauchen einen Token; `DEIN_TOKEN` durch den eigenen ersetzen ([Zugang und Limits](https://docs.mapx.at/de/start/access-and-limits.md)).

## Grundstück finden

Nach der Grundstücksnummer suchen (`KG 14143 Gst 473/1`, `14143/473/1`) oder das Grundstück an einem Punkt nehmen, etwa aus einem Klick oder einer Adresse:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode?q=Herrengasse%2013,%201010%20Wien&types=address&limit=1" | jq '.features[0].center'
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/15.3294,48.2272" | jq '.features[0].properties | {parcel_id, parcel_number, area_m2, is_building_land}'
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode?q=KG%2014143%20Gst%20473/1&types=parcel&limit=1" | jq '.features[0].properties.parcel_id'
```

## Dossier lesen

`/v1/parcels/{id}` liefert alles, was die offenen Daten zu einem Grundstück sagen, in einem Aufruf: Gemeinde und Bezirk, Fläche, Nutzungsanteile, Gebäude mit Höhen (wo das BEV sie hat), Geländestatistik, Adressen, die nächste Haltestelle, das Flugjahr des Orthophotos und einen fertigen Bildlink.

```js
const id = "14143-473_1"; // properties.parcel_id aus der Suche oder der Punktabfrage
const d = await (await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcels/${id}`, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json();
const p = d.properties;
console.log(
  `${p.parcel_number} in ${p.cadastral_municipality.name}, ${Math.round(p.area_m2)} m²`,
  `| Gebäude: ${p.buildings.count}`,
  `| ${p.elevation?.min_m}-${p.elevation?.max_m} m, Neigung ${p.elevation?.slope_mean_deg}°`,
  `| nächste Haltestelle: ${p.nearest_transit_stop?.name} (${p.nearest_transit_stop?.distance_m} m)`,
);
```

Fehlende Daten sind `null` oder leere Listen, nie abwesend. Für einen Punkt statt einer ID liefert `GET /v1/parcel/{lon},{lat}?include=dossier` dasselbe Dossier. Für einen Kartenklick siehe das Beispiel [Grundstück per Klick](https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/parcel-on-click.md).

## Ein Bild fürs Exposé

Das Dossier enthält `links.static_image`: ein Luftbild mit dem Grundstücksumriss. Der Link kommt ohne Token; vor dem Einbinden `?access_token=DEIN_TOKEN` anhängen. Für ein eigenes Bild das Polygon als GeoJSON-Overlay zeichnen und mit `auto` den Ausschnitt anpassen lassen:

```js
const parcel = (await (await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/15.3294,48.2272", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json()).features[0];
const outline = { type: "Feature", properties: { stroke: "#e11d48", "stroke-width": 3, fill: "#e11d48", "fill-opacity": 0.2 }, geometry: parcel.geometry };
const img = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/satellite/geojson(${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(outline))})/auto/800x500.webp?access_token=DEIN_TOKEN`;
document.querySelector("#expose").src = img; // für E-Mails und PDFs auf dem Server mit geheimem Token erzeugen
```

Für eine Planansicht `outdoors` oder `streets` statt `satellite` verwenden. `@2x` an der Größe liefert scharfe Bilder auf hochauflösenden Bildschirmen. Siehe [Statische Bilder](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/static-images.md). Die Bild-URL enthält den Token: für Bilder auf Webseiten einen öffentlichen Token (`mx_pk_…`) mit der eigenen Website als erlaubter Origin verwenden, Bilder für E-Mails und PDFs auf dem Server mit einem geheimen Token (`mx_sk_…`) erzeugen. Das Bild trägt die Attribution seiner Daten; im Layout sichtbar lassen ([Attribution](https://docs.mapx.at/de/reference/attribution.md)).

## Sonne, Hitze und Schnee am Standort

Käufer fragen nach Solarertrag, Sommerhitze und Schneelast. `/v1/climate/{lon},{lat}` antwortet aus Daten der GeoSphere Austria; dasselbe Objekt steht als `properties.climate` im Dossier (am inneren Punkt des Grundstücks). Jeder Abschnitt nennt Datensatz, Rasterzelle und letzten Datentag.

```js
const c = await (await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/climate/15.3294,48.2272", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json();
console.log(
  `Globalstrahlung: ${c.solar?.global_radiation_kwh_m2_year} kWh/m² pro Jahr, ${c.solar?.sunshine_hours_year} h Sonnenschein`,
  `| Jahresmittel ${c.temperature.mean_annual_c.normal} °C (1991-2020), Trend +${c.temperature.trend_c_per_decade} °C je Jahrzehnt`,
  `| Hitzetage (TX ≥ 30 °C): ${c.temperature_extremes.hot_days_per_year.normal} → ${c.temperature_extremes.hot_days_per_year.recent} pro Jahr`,
  `| Schneetage: ${c.snow.snow_days_per_winter.normal} pro Winter, jetzt ${c.snow.current.depth_cm} cm`,
  `| Dürre (SPEI 365): ${c.drought.spei365.class}`,
);
```

Eine grobe Photovoltaik-Abschätzung ist die Strahlung auf dem Dach mal Modulwirkungsgrad und Systemwirkungsgrad (etwa 0,8); der Wert dient der Orientierung und ersetzt keine Ertragsprognose. Die erste Anfrage für ein Gebiet, nach dem noch niemand gefragt hat, kann bis zu 20 Sekunden dauern, spätere kommen aus dem Cache. Im Dossier ist der Abschnitt `null` mit `status: "partial"`, bis die Daten geladen sind; nach `retry_after_s` erneut fragen. Referenz: [Climate API](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/climate.md). Den Quellenhinweis anzeigen: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 ([Quellenangaben](https://docs.mapx.at/de/reference/attribution.md)).

## Wie gut ist es erreichbar

Die Fläche zeigen, die zu Fuß oder mit dem Rad erreichbar ist, und die Entfernung zu wichtigen Orten.

```js
const here = [15.3294, 48.2272];
const iso = await (await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/isochrone/walking/${here}?contours_minutes=5,10,15`, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json(); // GeoJSON-Flächen

const places = [here, [15.3333, 48.2279], [15.3201, 48.2218]]; // Adresse, Schule, Bahnhof
const m = await (await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/matrix/walking/${places.map((p) => p.join(",")).join(";")}?sources=0`, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json();
console.log(m.durations[0].map((s) => Math.round(s / 60) + " min"));
```

Für den öffentlichen Verkehr die nächste Haltestelle aus dem Dossier und ihre [Abfahrten](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/transit.md) nehmen: `GET /v1/departures?stop=<Haltestellen-ID>&limit=5`. Das Beispiel nimmt Melk Bahnhof (`at:43:7226`).

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/departures?stop=at:43:7226&limit=3" | jq '.departures[] | {time, line: .line.name, headsign}'
```

**Python**

```python
import requests
r = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/departures", params={"stop": "at:43:7226", "limit": 3}, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN"}).json()
print([(d["time"][11:16], d["line"]["name"]) for d in r["departures"]])
```

# Logistik: Lkw-Routing und Matrix

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/use-cases/logistics/

> Lkw-Routing mit Fahrzeugmaßen, Fahrzeitmatrizen, Tourenplanung und Verkehr für Zustellung und Flotten, aufgebaut auf den mapx-APIs für Österreich.

Flotten- und Zustellsoftware braucht eine Route, die ein Lkw wirklich fahren kann, Fahrzeiten für viele Paare, eine gute Reihenfolge der Stopps und die aktuellen Verkehrsmeldungen. Alle vier sind je eine Anfrage. Koordinaten sind `lon,lat`, Zeiten in Sekunden, Distanzen in Metern.

Alle Aufrufe brauchen einen Token; `DEIN_TOKEN` durch den eigenen ersetzen ([Zugang und Limits](https://docs.mapx.at/de/start/access-and-limits.md)). Im Servercode einen geheimen Token (`mx_sk_…`) verwenden und ihn nie in eine Webseite einbauen.

## Lkw-Routen

Das Profil `driving-truck` nimmt die Fahrzeugmaße und meidet Straßen mit passenden Gewichts-, Höhen-, Breiten- und Längenbeschränkungen und Verboten. Ohne Angaben gelten 40 t, 4 m Höhe und 2,55 m Breite.

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/driving-truck/15.6256,48.2049;15.3294,48.2272?weight=40&height=4&width=2.55&length=16.5&truck_type=semi&overview=false" \
  | jq '.routes[0] | {distance, duration, truck, toll_go_km: .toll.truck_go_km}'
```

`routes[0].toll.truck_go_km` ist die GO-mautpflichtige Länge; je Schritt `truck_go_m`. Die Geschwindigkeiten folgen den Lkw-Limits (80 km/h auf Autobahnen). Bezirksweite Verbote aus Freitext-Verordnungen werden nicht geroutet: betroffene Straßen kommen als `steps[].notices[]` mit `type: "truck_restriction"`; der Disposition anzeigen. `exclude=toll` und `exclude=motorway` meiden Mautabschnitte und Autobahnen (Profile `driving`, `driving-traffic` und `driving-truck`); `exclude=ferry` gilt für alle Profile außer `driving-traffic`.

In JavaScript:

```js
const q = new URLSearchParams({ weight: 40, height: 4, width: 2.55, length: 16.5, truck_type: "semi", steps: true });
const r = await (await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/driving-truck/15.6256,48.2049;15.3294,48.2272?${q}`, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json();
const notices = r.routes[0].legs.flatMap((l) => l.steps).flatMap((s) => s.notices ?? []);
```

## Fahrzeiten für viele Paare

`matrix` beantwortet alle Paare in einer Anfrage, im Rahmen der Grenzen der [Matrix-API](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/directions.md). Mit `sources` und `destinations` (Indizes) lässt sich nur eine Zeile abfragen.

```js
const depots = [[16.3725, 48.2085], [15.3294, 48.2272], [14.2858, 48.3069]];
const q = depots.map((p) => p.join(",")).join(";");
const m = await (await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/matrix/driving/${q}?annotations=duration,distance`, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json();
console.log(m.durations[0][1] / 60, "min", m.distances[0][1] / 1000, "km"); // Wien nach Melk
```

## Tour planen

`POST /v1/optimization` teilt Aufträge Fahrzeugen zu und ordnet sie: Kapazität, Zeitfenster, Servicezeiten (Sekunden), Start und Ende je Fahrzeug. Höchstens 10 Fahrzeuge, 50 Aufträge und 60 verschiedene Orte je Anfrage. Nur mit geheimem Token (`mx_sk_…`) vom Server; ein öffentlicher Token bekommt `403 pk-not-allowed`.

```js
const body = {
  profile: "driving",
  vehicles: [{ id: 1, start: [16.3725, 48.2083], end: [16.3725, 48.2083], time_window: [28800, 61200] }],
  services: [
    { id: 1, location: [15.6256, 48.2049], service: 300, time_windows: [[32400, 43200]] },
    { id: 2, location: [14.2858, 48.3069], service: 600 },
  ],
};
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization", { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
const tour = await res.json();
console.log(tour.routes[0].steps.map((s) => s.id ?? s.type), tour.unassigned); // unassigned: Aufträge, die nicht passten
```

Das Ergebnis mit einer `directions`-Anfrage durch die Orte aus `tour.routes[0].steps` zeichnen (bis zu 25 Punkte); siehe das [Beispiel Tourenplanung](https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/optimization.md).

## Verkehr

`driving-traffic` berücksichtigt die Meldungen von ASFINAG und EVIS.AT: verbindliche Sperren werden umfahren, nicht verbindliche Sperren nach Möglichkeit gemieden, und auf Autobahnen bremsen die aktuell geschalteten Tempolimits der Wechselverkehrszeichen die Fahrzeit. Eine flächendeckende gemessene Verkehrslage (Geschwindigkeiten auf allen Straßen, Stau als „flow“) gibt es nicht; gemeldete Staus ohne Sperre ändern die Route nicht, sie erscheinen nur als Meldung. Meldungen auf der Route kommen mit `incidents=true` in `legs[].incidents`. Für eine Region die aktiven Meldungen auflisten oder den Verkehrsstil zeigen:

```js
const bbox = [14.5, 47.8, 16.9, 48.6]; // Niederösterreich
const { features } = await (await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents?bbox=${bbox}&active=true&type=construction&limit=50`, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer DEIN_TOKEN" } })).json();
console.log(features.length, features[0]?.properties.road, features[0]?.properties.text);
```

Der Kartenstil `traffic-day` zeigt die aktuellen Meldungen und Sperren und auf Autobahnen die Abschnitte mit Tempolimit durch Wechselverkehrszeichen (keine flächendeckende Verkehrslage); siehe das [Beispiel](https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/traffic.md). Verkehrsdaten: ASFINAG / EVIS.AT (CC BY 4.0).

## Nächste Schritte

- [Navigation](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/navigation.md): alle Profile und Parameter
- [Verkehr](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/traffic.md)
- [Fehler und Limits](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md): Rate-Limit-Zonen und was bei `429` zu tun ist
